intro.title: Where <highlight>Community</highlight> Begins
intro.paragraph1: Government Officers' Housing Society was founded to give government officers and their families a safe, well-managed place to call home. What began as a small residential initiative has grown into a thriving community defined by cooperation, transparency, and shared purpose.
intro.paragraph2: Today, GOHS supports over 500 member families through transparent financial management, responsive community services, and a genuine commitment to keeping neighbors connected.
